title: All About Lights: Recessed Light Installation (This Old House)

locations.name: attic
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly states 'We were up in the attic.'

summary: This Old House demonstrates a practical attic-to-ceiling recessed lighting install. The episode covers selecting a lighting location away from obstructions, drilling clean access holes, running Romex 14-2 between fixtures, and mounting remodel housings with plaster-clips. It contrasts quick push-in wire connections with traditional twisting and wire nuts, shows grounding and neutrals being tied in a junction box, and ends with a test of the new recessed lights. The workflow emphasizes dust control, cable length planning, and safe termination of an unused conductor from the switch loop.

Ground bonding to metal box and neutral/hot conductors coordinated in a junction box
